title: Labor group presses for P1,200 minimum wage, workers' rights; calls on youth to honor Bonifacio's legacy
summary: Workers' rights, low wages, and rising prices were among the issues raised by militant labor group Kilusang Mayo Uno (KMU) during a protest in Quezon City on Friday ahead of Bonifacio Day.
